rationale: Oversized diff (341KB): the blind lens read only the first ~3150 lines, so tail test hunks were not reviewed; 2.3 verified only a few candidates by targeted reads and unreached ones keep lens grading. Task shape (metadata/legacy contextId) and stale guide references miss FR-T5/FR-D1; commit-format standard fails on 4 planning commits. 0 deferred, roughly 20 filtered as noise or accepted-gap overlap.

business_review.notes: Task has no metadata field; legacy sessionId-only row serializes without contextId
Guide still cites deleted adapter.py / BedrockAdapter

AC7 Guide and version.py match implementation
AC8 Ruff and scoped A2A pytest pass

standards_review.notes: 4 subjects lack the EPMCDME-#### prefix: a2a-backward-compat, a2a-client-protocol, a2a-server-protocol, a2a-version-decision planning artifacts commits.
No Optional[]/bare generics found in changed a2a modules; license headers present.

findings.title: Guide cites deleted BedrockAdapter/adapter.py
findings.problem: The A2A guide's Evidence line, Rationale bullet (line 30) and Avoid table (line 24) still point to src/codemie/rest_api/a2a/client/adapter.py and BedrockAdapter, which this diff deletes. FR-D1/AC7 require the guide to match the implementation.
findings.impact: Spec requirement FR-D1/AC7 is partially unmet; future agents are directed to a nonexistent file as a shape/structure reference.
findings.recommendation: Remove or reword the adapter.py/BedrockAdapter references so the guide reflects the in-house v1.0 types and the legacy read-time normalisers.

findings.title: Sync client paths leak pydantic ValidationError
findings.problem: send_task/get_task/cancel_task build SendMessageRPCResponse(**body) etc. outside a try. A malformed or v0.3-shaped remote body (or non-list error.data, now typed List[dict]) raises ValidationError, which is not an A2AClientError; the streaming path already maps it to A2AClientJSONError.
findings.impact: The handler's except A2AClientError misses it, so a non-conformant remote yields HTTP 500 rather than a 400 chat error. Reachability was not confirmed by a full read of the call chain.
findings.recommendation: Wrap the response model construction in try/except (TypeError, ValidationError) and raise A2AClientJSONError, matching the streaming path.

findings.title: Stream frame without result or error crashes
findings.problem: In the streaming loop, when response.error is falsy the code dereferences response.result.task/.message/.statusUpdate/.artifactUpdate without checking result is None. A frame like {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1} raises AttributeError.
findings.impact: A remote emitting an empty frame aborts the stream with an unhandled exception instead of being skipped or reported as a protocol error.
findings.recommendation: Add `if stream_response is None: continue` (or raise A2AClientJSONError) before dereferencing.

findings.title: Task wire shape lacks metadata and legacy contextId
findings.problem: FR-T5 requires Task to serialize {id, contextId, status, artifacts, history, metadata}. Task has no metadata field (SQLModel reserves the name), and sessionId is exclude=True with only read sites applying `contextId or sessionId`, so a legacy row with only sessionId is served without contextId.
findings.impact: Serialized Task does not match the v1.0 fixture shape (AC1) and legacy tasks return a Task missing a required contextId; a missing required behavior.
findings.recommendation: Expose metadata via an alias/serialization workaround and populate contextId from sessionId at read time (before-validator or serializer) so the wire Task always carries contextId.

findings.title: Bedrock card ValueError escapes as HTTP 500
findings.problem: A2AClient.__init__ raises plain ValueError for bedrock_agentcore cards or bedrock hosts (client.py:89-94), but A2AAssistantHandler.__init__ only catches AgentCardInterfaceError. The card resolver additionally rejects any URL containing 'bedrock-agentcore' while the client checks hostname only.
findings.impact: Stored Bedrock AgentCore assistants now fail handler construction with an unmapped ValueError (500) instead of the 400 unusable-card error.
findings.recommendation: Catch (AgentCardInterfaceError, ValueError) and map to the 400 unusable-card error; use urlparse hostname consistently in resolver and client.

findings.title: TLS verify kwarg asserted only by presence
findings.problem: Tests at lines 258 and 412 assert only that a `verify` kwarg exists, never that it equals config.HTTPS_VERIFY_SSL.
findings.impact: Hardcoding verify=False (or True) passes tests, so a TLS-verification regression on outbound A2A calls would go undetected.
findings.recommendation: Assert kwargs['verify'] == config.HTTPS_VERIFY_SSL with the config value both True and False.

findings.title: No test for non-streaming dispatch failure
findings.problem: The router's final `except Exception` now returns -32603 InternalError carrying the request id (HTTP 400), but the only forced exception in router tests is the SSE path (RuntimeError 'stream exploded').
findings.impact: Dropping the handler, returning the wrong id, or leaking str(e) in the non-streaming path would ship unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Add a test patching CodemieTaskManager.on_get_task/on_send_task with RuntimeError asserting status 400, error.code -32603, matching request id, and no exception text in the body.

findings.title: Commit subjects lack EPMCDME ticket prefix
findings.problem: git-workflow.md requires the EPMCDME-####: Description format; four planning-artifact commits use '<slice-name>: add planning artifacts' (a2a-backward-compat, a2a-client-protocol, a2a-server-protocol, a2a-version-decision).
findings.impact: History would not carry the Jira ticket prefix; commit-format is a documented blocking standard.
findings.recommendation: Reword the four subjects to 'EPMCDME-15327: <slice> add planning artifacts', or ensure the squash-merge commit uses the ticket prefix.
